articles.title: Morgan Stanley Files to Launch Crypto ETFs, Joining a Crowded Field
articles.mainIdea: Morgan Stanley Files to Launch Crypto ETFs, Joining a Crowded Field
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Morgan Stanley Files to Launch Crypto ETFs, Joining a Crowded Field. Morgan Stanley plans to launch two exchange-traded funds tied to the price of cryptocurrencies Bitcoin and Solana, according to new filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Morgan Stanley would be the first bank with a large wealth management arm to offer such funds, but the field is already crowded with more than 100 crypto ETFs and more on the way. The new funds would be called Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust and Morgan Stanley Solana Trust. Related tickers mentioned: BTC-USD, MS, MS-PQ, SOL-USD.
